title: Marvel Tokon adds Venom, Thor and Jubilee 🕷️
subject: marveltokon
description:
Which fighter are you maining first? 👇

Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls revealed its full Year 1 DLC roster: Phoenix Cyclops on November 2, 2026, Jane Foster's Thor in winter 2027, Venom in spring 2027 and Jubilee in summer 2027. The tag-team fighter from Arc System Works is out now on PS5 and PC.

Sources: PlayStation / Arc System Works via VICE (Oct 11, 2026), Insider Gaming (Oct 11, 2026), PlayNews
Game footage/images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Venom is coming to Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls.
On October 11, PlayStation and Arc System Works revealed the full Year 1 DLC roster for the tag-team fighter.
Phoenix Cyclops kicks things off on November 2.
Jane Foster's Thor follows in winter 2027, then Venom in spring.
Jubilee closes out the season in summer 2027.
The pass includes four characters and one stage, and Marvel Tokon is out now on PS5 and PC.
